content.title: Tickets for Usher + Chris Brown shows are selling fast, get yours now
content.text: April 14, 2026Updated April 22, 2026, 4:52 p.m. ETR&B artists Usher and Chris Brown have announced a joint stadium tour for 2026.The tour includes 31 stops across the United States and two in Canada.Tickets are currently on sale, with the cheapest available price listed at $231.The full tour schedule runs from June through December of 2026.Usher and Chris Brown are bringing R&B back. The two superstars are heading out on tour together in 2026! They made a joint announcement on Instagram on Friday, April 10, both riding motorcycles before getting in an elevator together and pushing the button for "stadium."Needless to say, social media loved the announcement, but it came with no tour dates and no ticket releases, until Tuesday, April 14, when the full schedule was released. The R&B Tour is a full stadium tour, including 31 stops across the U.S. and two Canadian appearances. As of publication, the cheapest available tickets are $231 at Ford Field in Detroit on July 2 and at Nissan Stadium in Nashville on July 25.Shop Usher & Chris Brown tour ticketsHere's how to buy Usher & Chris Brown The R&B Tour tickets now:Shop Usher & Chris Brown The R&B Tour concert ticketsUsher & Chris Brown The R&B tour full US scheduleJune 26 - But, these are two R&B powerhouses, so we can probably expect something big for opening acts. As for guests, don't be surprised if they pull from their massive repertoire of hits and features. Usher's hits 'Yeah' and 'Lovers & Friends' which both feature Lil' Jon and Ludacris, while Chris Brown had top hits like 'Look At Me Now' featuring Busta Rhymes and even older hits like 'Shortie Like Mine' featuring Bow Wow. But, they could surprise us and bring out someone more unexpected too. You'll just have to be there to find out.Get Usher & Chris Brown concert tickets nowWhat is the set list for the Usher & Chris Brown tour?There has been no set list announcement made for the Usher and Chris Brown tour.
